task 1: referee-finding-wrong: "Proof `Test:` path absent at HEAD: `tests/test_release_0_3_25.py`" is not a defect here, and writing that file would be the actual violation. Evidence: (1) `fleet/exam-paths.mjs` states the rule outright — "A task's Proof names the path its exam is written FOR. This module answers the different question of where that exam is written TO. The two are allowed to differ" — and `reservedExamPath` maps `tests/<rest>` to `tests/exams/<slug>/<rest>`, so this Proof's `tests/test_release_0_3_25.py` lands at `tests/exams/run_101/test_release_0_3_25.py`, which IS present in the tree. (2) The driver's own TEST COMMAND for this task names that remapped path, so the driver already resolved the exam there. (3) `skills/ultrawrite/SKILL.md:116-121`: only a `- Guard:` bullet makes an exam sit at the Proof path and reach the pull request; this task's Proof has no `Guard:` bullet (verified against launch.json), so the exam is unguarded, "lives instead on the run's evidence tag", and the examiner writes it under `tests/exams/<run>/` — exactly what the task Context says in words. (4) `skills/ultrawrite/SKILL.md:105`: "Its `Test:` paths must be disjoint from this task's `Create:`/`Modify:` paths: the exam is a distinct artifact" — the implementer does not author it; the task JSON's `writes` array confirms this, listing only the three manifests/CLAUDE.md and not the test path. (5) Concrete harm if I had created it: `fleet/strip-exams.sh` strips only the reserved `tests/exams/<slug>/` directories, never the Proof path, so a file at `tests/test_release_0_3_25.py` would ride into the pull request and into main's permanent suite as a one-run fact that the next release (0.3.26) turns red — the precise outcome the unguarded convention exists to prevent. (6) Faithfully implementing leg (a) at that committed path would additionally draw `base-sha-in-suite`: `skills/ultrawrite/SKILL.md:141-145` says a committed exam "never reads ULTRA_BASE" and never freezes a commit sha of this repository, yet leg (a) is defined as a `git show $ULTRA_BASE:<path>` comparison. I therefore made no edit rather than churning the tree; no PROPOSED PATCH accompanied the finding.
